Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-film.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Implement owner-selected F0 alternative A only: unsupported caption-derived film claims remain Hypothesized; SurfaceExplicit keeps its text license and HumanAdjudicated requires a claim-specific record. Use the preserved September film phase plan and qualify the exact downstream consumer; no scientific accuracy follows.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md
Phase-plan ticket: bd-01M2TAGST4EBFR1HM9Q3EWSYAH
Film parent: bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P

This ticket is an executable child created from the cold-reviewed filing payload. Its blocking edges are authoritative; parent relation is organizational only.

Owner answer recorded (F0, 2026-09-21): alternative A. Cite docs/refactor/evidence/film-f0-claim-status-20260921/README.md.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Implement A only: SurfaceExplicit keeps its text meaning (directly stated by source text, span law intact). A caption- or model-derived film claim with no other license is Hypothesized with complete derivation retained. HumanAdjudicated requires an adjudication record for that particular emitted claim; human authorship of an annotation alone is not adjudication. Other statuses require their own family-specific basis. Text SurfaceExplicit assignments are not reused as a film default.
2. No public basis/component change is expected under A; if one proves necessary, stop and record an ADR entry first.
3. Same sentence as source text versus film derivative remains distinguishable. High raw score or accepted resolution alone cannot license film SurfaceExplicit; human authorship alone is not specific adjudication.
4. Join expected source bundle, recipe/model/request, output-bound caption proposal, receipt and sampled-frame inventory. Substitution and borrowed licenses on another bundle refuse.
5. Keep caption hull and exact sampled-frame inventory distinct; preserve claim-union gaps and text StatusWeight/calibrated override semantics.
6. A lawful film control and compiled deletion of the selected license/provenance guard establish that the policy fires. Selected public basis/component changes have explicit ADR and API/wire inventory entries.

Required gates:
- Separate committed-source SD6 cold review with findings resolved.
- Named compiled mutations and independent accepting controls; compile-door witnesses clean both Compile and Test and prove both recompilations.
- Clean exact-candidate standalone provider compileAll/testAll, separate format checks, frozen S0 values and applicable WOG backend byte court.
- Executable docs examples for public API changes; exact-pinned storyatlas consumer suite when its dependencies or interfaces are touched.
- Local evidence and commits only; no push or scientific/CI qualification implied.

Scope limits:
- No alternative-B basis, no generic model-wire or calibrated truth claim.

Plan sections: §7.
